audit.whatIsWrong: matchup-lint still reported MISGENDER / COPY_PASTE_BLEED / COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT / DISPLAY_ARTIFACT on zoe after the proposal pass; the original edits for these fields were rejected by the 10% length-drift rule, so the defects survived on disk.
audit.why: Pronouns come from champ-data/champ-gender.js; bleed bullets promise one thing in the title and paste the generic trade line in the body; a cooldowns field with no digit carries no information. Replacement cooldowns and interactions are taken from champ-data/_kits/zoe.json and champ-data/_kits/karma.json.
audit.corrected: The same corrections re-cut to fit inside the length-drift budget so that they actually apply.

edits.before: Commit on Sleepy Trouble Bubble’s cooldown, on your Blackfire Torch spike, and with your jungler’s setup. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on Sleepy Trouble Bubble's 18-second cooldown, on your Blackfire Torch spike, and with your jungler's setup. Make her flinch first.

edits.before: Eat his poke during Mantra downtime. Burn the shield on chip damage. Trade combos at even HP — chip first. Save the R for moments with names on them.
edits.after: Eat her poke during Mantra downtime. Burn the shield on chip damage. Trade combos at even HP — chip first. Save the R for moments with names on them.

edits.before: - Zoe Sleepy Trouble Bubble: matchup-defining — Sleep into empowered Q is the entire kill pattern — body-block it with minions or terrain. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your RE shield-speed like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sleepy Trouble Bubble: 18s at rank 1 and 14s at rank 5 — body-block it with minions, because the sleep cuts your MR and doubles the hit that wakes you. - Paddle Star! runs 8.5s down to 6.5s. - Portal Jump is only 11/8/5s, so she is never truly out of range.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, and on real windows RQ-W: the chunk plus tether-root turns a poke trade into a kill setup — E out before the answer.
edits.after: Shield before the sleep breaks, not after: Inspire eats the doubled waking hit and its move speed walks you out of Paddle Star.

notes: QA lint-repair pass. Every after-string was length-checked against the on-disk before (<10% drift) and screened for elo tiers, non-interactions and filler before being written. Spell-shield, cleanse, QSS and tenacity behaviour is absent from the kit files (needsResearch is empty by design) and is asserted nowhere here.
